summary: Iteration 29 - Legal Compliance System Testing. All 17 backend tests passed. All frontend tests passed. Fixed a bug in legal document version sorting (was sorting by version string instead of created_at timestamp).

issues: Terms content is very short (test data) - shows 'Updated Terms vz_xxx' with minimal content. This is test data pollution, not a bug.

critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: /app/backend/routers/legal.py - get_latest_doc() was sorting by 'version' string which caused incorrect ordering (e.g., 'test_14b28c' < 'test_fa83b4' alphabetically). Changed to sort by 'created_at' timestamp to get the most recently created version.
seed_data_creation: Created multiple test users with consents during testing. Created multiple test versions of terms document during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 29 tested the complete legal compliance system. All features working: (1) Public legal document endpoints return markdown content with version info. (2) Registration requires all 3 consents (terms, privacy, disclaimer) or returns 400. (3) Consent records are stored in user_consents collection with user_id, document_type, document_version, accepted_at, ip_address. (4) Consent status endpoint checks if user has accepted latest versions. (5) Admin can create new document versions via PUT /api/v1/admin/legal/{doc_type}. (6) Re-consent modal blocks app access when user has pending consents. (7) Legal footer with Terms|Privacy|Disclaimer links visible on login and register pages. Fixed bug: get_latest_doc() now sorts by created_at instead of version string.

bugs_fixed.issue: get_latest_doc() returned wrong version when multiple versions exist
bugs_fixed.root_cause: Sorting by 'version' string descending doesn't work correctly for non-numeric versions (e.g., 'test_14b28c' < 'test_fa83b4' alphabetically)
bugs_fixed.fix: Changed sort from [('version', -1)] to [('created_at', -1)] to get the most recently created version
